lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Vanguard One, this is Malik. Two minutes to the drop zone. Final check.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Chute's good. Rifle's good. Let's get this done.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: The Red Jackals hold a fuel outpost below you. Their commander keeps a laptop with all their supply routes. We want it.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Ramp is open. Green light. Go, go, go!

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Watch your altitude, Kade. Open your chute before you hit five hundred metres.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: I see you. Steer for the green smoke, west of the outpost.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Good landing. The outpost is to the north east. Stay quiet. If they see you, they'll sound the alarm.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: See that radio mast? It's their only link to the valley. Take it down and nobody hears them call for help.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Good. They're deaf now. Find the commander's office. The laptop should be inside.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Got the laptop. There's a file here called Dead Hand.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Dead Hand? Bring it home, Kade. Raven is inbound to the landing zone, south of the outpost.

lines.speaker: raven
lines.text: Vanguard One, Raven. Wheels down. Get aboard!

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Nice work. Let's see what Dead Hand really is.

lines.speaker: raven
lines.text: This is as close as I can get you. Good luck, Vanguard.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: The pass is the only road deeper into the valley. A Red Jackal checkpoint guards it, next to a small village.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Knock out their radio antenna first. Then find the gate keycard. The checkpoint commander lives in the village.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Good. Now the keycard. Try the commander's house.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: The gate controls are in the guard booth. Open it up.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Gate's open. Rauf is waiting on the other side.

lines.speaker: rauf
lines.text: Dead Hand isn't a code name. It's a warhead. And it's already in this valley.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Then we find it. Good work, both of you.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: That radar on the hill sees every helicopter in the valley. As long as it stands, Raven can't fly.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Cameras cover the whole station. Shut them down from the control room, then blow the dish.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Nice. They're blind. Get to the radar dish.

lines.speaker: kade
lines.text: Charges set on the dish. Moving away.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Radar's gone! Raven, you're clear to fly.

lines.speaker: raven
lines.text: Coming in hot, Vanguard. Get to the landing pad!

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Good work, Kade. The valley is open to us now.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: They've raised the alarm. Expect more of them.

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Careful, a camera just spotted you!

lines.speaker: malik
lines.text: Kade, you're hurt. Use a medkit.
